name: Lucia Caminos
bio: Lucia's father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk. Fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; after getting out she wants a better life than the one she was handed — and teams up with Jason to take it. The first female protagonist in a mainline 3D GTA.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Lucia Caminos) and Trailers 1 & 2

name: Jason Duval
bio: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled past, he ended up in the Keys doing what he knows best — working for local drug runners. Maybe it's time to try something new.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Jason Duval) and Trailers 1 & 2

name: Cal Hampton
bio: Jason's friend and associate. Cal is a paranoid homebody who'd rather stay in with a beer, listening in on Coast Guard radio chatter and reading up on conspiracies, than face the world outside.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Cal Hampton)

name: Boobie Ike
bio: A Vice City legend who turned street success into a legitimate-looking empire of real estate, a strip club and a recording studio. Boobie knows business is all about who you know.

relationships.relation: Business partner at Only Raw Records

source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Boobie Ike)

name: Dre'Quan Priest
bio: Dre'Quan was always more about hustle than talent. After years dealing on the streets, he's set on becoming a music mogul — and he's betting everything on Real Dimez through Only Raw Records.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Dre'Quan Priest)

name: Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe & Roxy)
bio: Bae-Luxe and Roxy are best friends since high school who've already gone viral once. Now signed to Only Raw Records, the rap duo is ready to turn social-media hustle into real stardom.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Real Dimez)

name: Raul Bautista
bio: A seasoned, charming bank robber who's always looking for new talent — and is willing to take bigger risks than most for a bigger payday.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Raul Bautista)

name: Brian Heder
bio: An old-school drug runner who has been moving product through the Keys since the glory days. Brian lets Jason live rent-free in one of his properties in exchange for help with his business.
source: Rockstar Games — official GTA VI website (Brian Heder)
